def mem(t, e, taus):
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    e = np.asarray(e, float)
    dt = np.diff(t)
    if np.any(dt <= 0):
        raise ValueError('time must be strictly increasing')
    r = np.diff(e) / dt
    D = np.zeros((len(t), len(taus)))
    for (i, (h, v)) in enumerate(zip(dt, r), 1):
        D[i] = D[i - 1] * np.exp(-h / taus) + v * taus * -np.expm1(-h / taus)
    return D

def fit(t, e, y, taus):
    from scipy.optimize import nnls
    D = np.c_[e, mem(t, e, taus)]
    Q = np.c_[np.ones(len(t)), t]
    P = lambda z: z - Q @ np.linalg.lstsq(Q, z, rcond=None)[0]
    B = P(D)
    z = P(y)
    w = np.ones(len(y))
    b = None
    for _ in range(12):
        sw = np.sqrt(w)
        norms = np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(B * sw[:, None], axis=0), 1e-12)
        (c, _) = nnls(B * sw[:, None] / norms, z * sw, maxiter=5000)
        b = c / norms
        r = y - D @ b - Q @ np.linalg.lstsq(Q, y - D @ b, rcond=None)[0]
        s = 1.4826 * np.median(abs(r - np.median(r))) + 1e-10
        nw = np.minimum(1, 1.345 * s / np.maximum(abs(r), 1e-12))
        if np.max(abs(nw - w)) < 1e-05:
            break
        w = nw
    return b
